title: A part sale to an internal customer stays a billable part sale
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part Sales.
  2. Start a New Part Sale.
  3. Pick customer A.
  4. Add a part with a sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part Sales opens.

Step 2:

  • The new part sale opens.

Step 3:

  • No "Internal" badge shows next to customer A.

Step 4:

  • The part shows its sell price; the part sale offers no Convert action, no "Close Work Order" and no NO CHARGE stamp.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Part sales. A part sale to an internal customer is a regular billable part sale: no badge, no Convert action, no Close, no NO CHARGE stamp. Components shared with part sales change only for work orders.”
